name: Demetris Theocharides
bio: Demetris Theocharides received his BSc in Information Technology from the Alexander Technological Educational Institute of Thessaloniki. With over 4 years of experience as a Software Developer, he has worked as a Frontend Developer at Amdocs Optima and as an Implementation Analyst at Jenus Technologies. He is currently a Software Engineer I at the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, where he contributes to the development and maintenance of research software platforms.
shortBio: Software Engineer developing research platforms at KIOS CoE.
